title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Lambda on Ridge Regression
text: When lambda (λ) is set to $$0$$, ridge regression becomes equivalent to ordinary least squares regression, which always has a unique solution if the design matrix has full column rank.

title: Unique Solution in Linear Regression
text: In linear regression, a unique solution exists if the design matrix has full column rank, meaning its columns are linearly independent.

hintAnswer: Yes if the columns are linearly independent.
title: Checking Full Column Rank
text: Does the design matrix in this problem have full column rank?
choices: Yes if the columns are linearly independent.
